item.amber.name: Amber
item.amber.description: Precious forest resin mined from ancient roots and carried to the Mound.

item.amber-carapace.description: +4 armor. Activate: absorb 180 damage for up to 8s. 45s cooldown.

item.amber-hourglass.description: +100 maximum mana. Activate: reduce remaining hero ability cooldowns by 12s. Does not affect items. 100s cooldown.

item.canopy-aegis.description: +5 armor. Activate: shield allied units within 6 tiles for 180 damage each for up to 8s. 80s cooldown.

item.deep-moon-scepter.description: +220 maximum mana, +2 mana per second and 20% shorter hero ability cooldowns. Does not affect items.

item.thornband.name: Thornband

item.warcaller-standard.description: Aura: allied units within 6 tiles gain 10% attack damage.

item.winter-heart.description: +180 maximum health. Aura: enemies within 5 tiles move 15% slower. Activate: deal 120 magic damage within 5 tiles and slow attack speed by 20% for 4s. 60s cooldown.
item.worldroot-heart.name: Worldroot Heart
item.worldroot-heart.description: +450 maximum health and +4 health per second. Activate: restore 20% maximum health. 70s cooldown.
